institution.name: Pomeroy College of Nursing at Crouse Hospital

plan.notes: Source: Pomeroy College of Nursing at Crouse Hospital official 'PROGRAM PLAN OF STUDY' (Fall & Spring Traditional Day Option, for students entering January 2020 and after), transcribed exactly: four semesters (18/17/15/15) = 65 credits total. Course titles and credits transcribed verbatim from the plan-of-study document. The catalog/college confirms graduates are awarded the Associate in Applied Science (AAS) in Nursing and are eligible for NCLEX-RN. Semester 1: NUR 105 Foundations of Nursing Practice (8), BSC 201 Human Anatomy and Physiology I (4), PSY 101 Introductory Psychology (3), WRT 101 Critical Writing (3) = 18. Semester 2: NUR 131 Cognitive and Maladaptive Behaviors (4), NUR 132 Homeostasis, Oxygenation and Regulation (6), BSC 202 Human Anatomy and Physiology II (4), PSY 220 Human Lifespan Development (3) = 17. Semester 3: NUR 215 Individual and Family Nursing (8), NUR 245 Pharmacology (3), BSC 205 Basic Microbiology (4) = 15. Semester 4: NUR 265 Homeostasis, Oxygenation and Regulation II (7), NUR 275 Professional Development (5), BSC 203 Nutrition (3) = 15. Total 65. The college also offers evening/weekend and LPN advanced-placement tracks that were not separately collected. Prerequisites are not published in the Plan of Study document; semester order is as published. No courses invented.
